module-2-notes-organizer-project.label: Project: Class Notes Handoff
module-2-notes-organizer-project.summary: Build a notes workspace, write a handoff file, move notes, and remove only temporary scratch.

module-2-notes-organizer-project-termina.title: Milestone 1: Complete the Organizer Structure
module-2-notes-organizer-project-termina.prompt: The organizer inbox already contains `math.txt`, `history.txt`, and `tmp-scratch.txt`. Add the missing `handoff` and `archive` folders, then inspect the organizer to make sure the incoming notes are still untouched.
module-2-notes-organizer-project-termina.hint: Preserve every incoming note. This milestone only completes the directory structure.

help.concept: A cumulative workspace preserves the incoming notes while the organizer structure is completed.
help.hint_1: The inbox already exists because it contains the incoming files.
help.hint_2: Create only the missing organizer directories and verify them.

module-2-notes-organizer-project-termina.title: Milestone 2: Write the Handoff README
module-2-notes-organizer-project-termina.prompt: Now create the handoff guide. Write `Substitute teacher handoff` as the first line of `class-notes-organizer/handoff/README.txt`, add `Bring math worksheets` as the second line, and read the file to check the result.
module-2-notes-organizer-project-termina.hint: Preserve the completed folders and inbox notes while adding only the handoff documentation.

help.concept: The second milestone adds handoff documentation without discarding the workspace created earlier.
help.hint_1: The README needs two lines in the specified order.
help.hint_2: Read the completed file after writing it.

module-2-notes-organizer-project-termina.starterCode:

mkdir -p class-notes-organizer/archive
ls class-notes-organizer

0.message: Use `echo` with `>` to write the first line.

1.message: Use `>>` to append the second line.

0.message: Do not use sudo in this beginner workspace.

1.message: Do not use recursive rm in this course.

2.message: Permissions commands are not needed for this workspace.

module-2-notes-organizer-project-termina.solutionCode:
mkdir -p class-notes-organizer/handoff
mkdir -p class-notes-organizer/archive
ls class-notes-organizer
echo "Substitute teacher handoff" > class-notes-organizer/handoff/README.txt
echo "Bring math worksheets" >> class-notes-organizer/handoff/README.txt
cat class-notes-organizer/handoff/README.txt

module-2-notes-organizer-project-termina.hint: The real notes must survive in the archive; only the explicitly named scratch file should disappear.

help.concept: The final milestone archives real notes and deletes only the confirmed temporary scratch file.
help.hint_1: Both subject notes must end in the archive.
help.hint_2: The README must remain and only the scratch file should vanish.

project-synopsis.title: Module 2 Project: Class Notes Handoff
project-synopsis.bodyMarkdown: A substitute teacher receives real notes plus one temporary scratch file in the organizer inbox. Complete the organizer, write the handoff README, then archive the real notes and remove only the named scratch file. Each milestone carries the complete previous workspace forward.
